summary: Iteration 128: Prelaunch checklist sections 2.3g (Services pricing), 2.3h (Promotional Items pricing), 2.3i (Custom/Other pricing). 23 tests passed, 2 xfailed (documented bugs). 3 confirmed bugs found.

critical.issue: BUG 2.3g-2: ServiceType enum lacks 'graphic_design' value. Config available_service_types uses key 'graphic_design' but enum only has 'design'. Passing service_type='graphic_design' causes HTTP 500 (Pydantic validation error). Additionally, the valid enum value 'design' doesn't match any key in the config → silently falls back to general_labor, so graphic_design billing rates/minimums are NEVER used.
critical.fix: Add GRAPHIC_DESIGN = 'graphic_design' to ServiceType enum (and similarly verify all other enum values match config keys). Remove now-unused DESIGN='design' or map it. Check all ServiceType values against available_service_types keys in pricing config.

critical.issue: BUG 2.3i-2: create_job_ticket() handler does NOT copy data.description into the JobTicket model constructor (job_tickets.py lines 1430-1454). The description field is silently dropped when creating a job ticket. Similarly, entry_mode, manual_quote_override, linked_order_file_ids, item_artwork_file_ids are all missing from the JobTicket() constructor call.
critical.fix: Add description=data.description, entry_mode=data.entry_mode, manual_quote_override=data.manual_quote_override, linked_order_file_ids=data.linked_order_file_ids, item_artwork_file_ids=data.item_artwork_file_ids to the JobTicket() constructor call at line ~1430.

minor.issue: BUG 2.3h-5: calculate_promotional() does NOT implement double-sided upcharge. The double_sided_art field in JobItemPricingData is present but never read by the promotional calculator. Sending double_sided_art='different' has zero effect on price.
minor.fix: Add double-sided multiplier logic to calculate_promotional(). If data.double_sided_art is 'different' or 'same', apply an upcharge multiplier (e.g., 1.5x for 'different', 1.2x for 'same') to suggested_price.

critical_code_review_comments: CRITICAL: ServiceType enum (enums.py) uses 'design' but available_service_types config uses 'graphic_design' as key. The calculate_services() function matches st_key against config keys, so enum value 'design' will ALWAYS fall back to general_labor — the graphic_design billing rates ($95/hr, min $25) are completely unreachable. This affects all service types: audit the full enum-to-config key mapping.

CRITICAL: create_job_ticket() handler does not persist description, entry_mode, manual_quote_override, linked_order_file_ids, item_artwork_file_ids. These are all defined in JobTicketCreate but not copied to the JobTicket model. Any client sending these fields will lose the data silently.

MEDIUM: calculate_promotional() at line 447 uses get_category_pricing_config(defaults, 'custom') — it should use 'promotional' or 'promo_misc' category config, not 'custom'. This means promotional pricing uses custom category markup/margin defaults instead of promotional-specific ones.

LOW: POST /api/pricing/calculate returns 500 for invalid enum values (e.g., service_type='graphic_design') instead of 422. The try/except at line 103 of pricing.py catches Pydantic ValidationError and re-raises as 500 with 'Calculation error:' prefix. It should catch ValidationError separately and return 422.

bug_2.3g-2.root_cause: ServiceType enum in enums.py uses abbreviated values (e.g., 'design') while available_service_types config in pricing defaults uses descriptive keys (e.g., 'graphic_design'). calculate_services() matches data.service_type.value against config keys — since 'design' ≠ 'graphic_design', it falls back to general_labor. Also, passing 'graphic_design' directly causes Pydantic ValidationError → 500.
bug_2.3g-2.fix: In models/enums.py: rename DESIGN='design' to GRAPHIC_DESIGN='graphic_design'. Audit all 18 ServiceType values against config keys.

bug_2.3i-2.issue: Job ticket description field dropped on create
bug_2.3i-2.root_cause: create_job_ticket() in routes/job_tickets.py lines 1430-1454 constructs JobTicket(...) object but omits description=data.description from the constructor kwargs. The field exists in both JobTicketCreate (line 382) and JobTicket (line 343) models but the bridge is missing.
bug_2.3i-2.fix: Add description=data.description to JobTicket() constructor at line ~1454. Also add entry_mode=data.entry_mode, manual_quote_override=data.manual_quote_override.
bug_2.3i-2.reproduction: POST /api/job-tickets {description: 'test'} → create succeeds → GET /api/job-tickets/{id} returns description=''

bug_2.3h-5.root_cause: calculate_promotional() in server.py lines 445-504 never reads double_sided_art or any double-sided field. The field exists in JobItemPricingData but the function only uses unit_cost, promo_product_type, markup_percent, rush_order, and quantity.
bug_2.3h-5.fix: In calculate_promotional(), check data.double_sided_art: if 'different', apply ~1.5x material cost multiplier; if 'same', apply ~1.2x.
bug_2.3h-5.reproduction: POST /api/pricing/calculate {category:promotional, pricing_data:{double_sided_art:'different'}} vs same without → identical prices
